palindrome:
Creating a palindrome with more than 255 characters requires careful planning to ensure that the structure remains symmetrical. Below is an example of a palindrome in Chinese, as it uses fewer characters per character compared to English:

中 国 是 我 的 家 床。床 家 我 的 是 中国。

In English letters, a shorter palindrome would look like this: "Able , was I saw Elba."
